instruction: The "~/pictures/" directory in my file system has photo files organized in sub-directories for each vacation spot. Compress them and save them in "~/pictures/vacations/<vacation_spot>.zip" for each vacation spot, and then delete all vacation spot sub-directories. Here, <vacation_spot> is the name of the vacation spot as it appears in the sub-directory name.

file_access_token = res['access_token']
spots = [p.rstrip('/').split('/')[-1] for p in listing_dirs]
spot_to_dir = {spot: d for spot, d in zip(spots, listing_dirs)}
print('spots', spots)
print('spot_to_dir', spot_to_dir)

zip_paths = {spot: f"~/pictures/vacations/{spot}.zip" for spot in spots}
print('zip_paths', zip_paths)

# Compress each spot directory into the required zip path
compress_results = {}
for spot in spots:
    dpath = spot_to_dir[spot]
    zpath = zip_paths[spot]
    print('\nCompressing', dpath, '->', zpath)
    comp_res = apis.file_system.compress_directory(directory_path=dpath, access_token=file_access_token, compressed_file_path=zpath)
    print('compress_res', comp_res)
    compress_results[spot] = comp_res

# Delete each spot directory after compression
delete_results = {}
for spot in spots:
    dpath = spot_to_dir[spot]
    print('\nDeleting', dpath)
    del_res = apis.file_system.delete_directory(directory_path=dpath, access_token=file_access_token)
    print('delete_res', del_res)
    delete_results[spot] = del_res

print('\nDone operations')
print('compress_results keys', list(compress_results.keys()))
print('delete_results keys', list(delete_results.keys()))
